verdict.rationale: Instinct is itself an autonomous personal-assistant agent that uses other products' surfaces. It exposes no API or developer surface of its own, so issuing scoped API credentials to an agent is a server/platform role outside its product type. The reviewer's workaround of putting only one credential in the Vault and using a spend-limited card is a user-side arrangement. It does not show the product issuing scoped credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
